jobs_results.title: Client Servicing Intern – Digital Marketing
jobs_results.description:
Location: Pune

Experience: Freshers / 0–1 year

Employment Type: 6-Month Internship | PPO Based on Performance







About Olio Maximus




Olio Maximus is the B2B marketing and consulting vertical of Olio Global AdTech. We work with manufacturers, engineering companies and B2B businesses to build stronger brands and generate business through digital marketing.




About the Role




We’re looking for a Client Servicing Intern who is organised, communicative and curious about digital marketing.




You’ll work alongside our account management and strategy teams, helping coordinate projects, communicate with clients and make sure tasks move forward smoothly.




You don’t need to be a digital marketing expert. We’re looking for someone who can learn quickly, communicate professionally and take ownership of their work.




What You’ll Do




Coordinate with clients and internal teams on ongoing projects.Follow up on content, approvals, requirements and deliverables.Maintain task lists, timelines and project updates.Assist with client communication and basic reporting.Support the team in executing digital marketing activities.Track project requirements and make sure important tasks don’t get missed.Participate in client discussions and internal meetings.Assist with day-to-day client servicing and account management activities.Learn the fundamentals of SEO, social media, Google Ads and lead generation.Gradually take ownership of tasks as you learn.


What We’re Looking For




Basic understanding or genuine interest in digital marketing.Strong formal written and verbal communication skills.Good organisation and follow-up skills.Comfortable communicating with clients and internal teams.Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.Proactive attitude and willingness to take ownership.Comfortable asking questions and seeking clarification.Willingness to learn marketing beyond just social media.Ability to take feedback and improve.


You don’t need in-depth knowledge of SEO, Google Ads or client servicing. A good foundation, communication skills and willingness to learn matter more.




Freshers, recent graduates and candidates with internship, college project or basic agency exposure are welcome to apply.




What You’ll Learn




During the internship, you’ll get practical exposure to:




Client communication and servicingDigital marketing strategyAccount managementSEOSocial media marketingGoogle AdsLead generationCampaign planningReporting and performance trackingProject and deadline management


You’ll work closely with strategists, marketers and client teams and learn how digital marketing is planned, executed and measured for real businesses.




Growth Opportunity




This is a 6-month internship with a PPO opportunity based on performance.




During the internship, you’ll build your digital marketing knowledge, develop client management skills and gradually take on more responsibility.




Intern → Learn Client Servicing → Understand Digital Marketing Strategy → PPO Based on Performance → Grow into an Account Manager / Growth Consultant




Why Olio Maximus?




At Olio Maximus, we don't expect interns to know everything. We invest in training people who show curiosity, ownership and the willingness to grow.




If you’re organised, curious and enjoy working with people, this could be a great place to start your career.




How to Apply




Send your CV to [redacted] and CC: [redacted].




Tell us briefly why you’re interested in digital marketing, client communication and client servicing.

Wayzon Technology Services Pvt. Ltd. is hiring for Marketing Intern 

 About the Company 

 Wayzon Technology Services Pvt. Ltd. is a software company founded in 2013. Over the last six years, the company has been working in the fields of Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) and vision systems, helping create technology-driven solutions for industrial and business applications. The company is inviting applications for a Marketing Intern to support general marketing, digital marketing, search engine optimization, and social media optimization initiatives. This six-month, full-time, on-site opportunity in Pune is suitable for a fresher with an MBA in Marketing and offers practical exposure within a technology-focused organization. High-performing interns may be considered for a performance-based pre-placement offer. 

 Responsibilities 

 Assist with general marketing planning, campaign execution, brand communication, and business outreach.  Support digital marketing activities across relevant online channels, including content coordination and social media initiatives.  Assist with SEO activities such as keyword research, on-page optimization, website content improvements, and basic search performance tracking.  Support SMO initiatives by planning social media content, improving engagement, and monitoring audience interactions.  Conduct market research, competitor tracking, customer and audience analysis, and lead-generation activities.  Help prepare website content, presentations, campaign updates, reports, and marketing communication materials.  Track campaign, website, search, and social media performance metrics and share actionable observations with the team.  Requirements 

 Fresher with an MBA or relevant management education, preferably specializing in Marketing.  Interest in general marketing, digital marketing, SEO, SMO, branding, content, market research, and business development.  Strong written and verbal communication skills with a proactive, organized approach to work.  Comfortable working full time from the Pune office for the complete six-month internship.  Ability to learn quickly, collaborate effectively, and take ownership of tasks.  Industry:  Software, Industrial IoT and Vision Systems

jobs_results.title: Social Media & Content Growth Intern – Creator Cove
jobs_results.job_title: Social Media & Content Growth Intern – Creator Cove
jobs_results.description:
The Role




This is not a traditional social media internship.




You will be responsible for *creating content, understanding what makes content go viral, experimenting with formats and actively growing Creator Cove's Instagram audience.*




You will work closely with the founders and marketing team to develop content that gets *views, shares, saves, comments, followers and creator participatio




Key Responsibilities




1. Instagram Growth




* Develop and execute strategies to grow Creator Cove's Instagram followers organically.

* Research trending content formats, sounds, memes, hooks and creator trends.

* Identify opportunities for Creator Cove to participate in relevant trends.

* Experiment with Reels, carousels, Stories, collaborations and other Instagram formats.

* Track weekly growth in followers, reach, engagement and content performance.

* Study competitor and creator accounts to identify successful content strategies.




2. Content Creation




* Create and publish Instagram Reels, carousels, Stories and static posts.

* Develop creative hooks and concepts designed for high retention and shareability.

* Create content around:




 * Creator tips

 * Instagram growth

 * Content creation

 * AI tools for creators

 * Editing tips

 * Creator economy trends

 * Influencer marketing

 * Brand collaborations

 * Creator success stories

 * Memes and relatable creator content

 * Creator Cove products, events and courses

* Repurpose long-form content into short-form social content.




 3. Content Research




* Spend time every day researching what is trending across Instagram, YouTube and other creator platforms.

* Maintain a database of interesting content ideas, hooks, trends and references.

* Identify emerging creators, formats and trends that Creator Cove can leverage.

* Understand *why a piece of content is performing*, not just what is trending.




4. Content Calendar




* Build and maintain a weekly/monthly content calendar.

* Plan a consistent posting schedule.

* Balance educational, entertaining, inspirational, promotional and community-driven content.

* Ensure Creator Cove maintains a strong and recognizable content identity.




5. Community Building




* Engage with creators, followers and relevant communities.

* Respond to comments and DMs.

* Identify potential creator collaborations.

* Help build relationships with emerging creators and micro-influencers.

* Encourage creators to participate in Creator Cove initiatives and events.




6. Analytics & Optimization




* Track Instagram Insights and content performance.

* Monitor:




 * Follower growth

 * Reach

 * Reel views

 * Watch time

 * Engagement rate

 * Shares

 * Saves

 * Profile visits

 * Follows generated per post

* Conduct weekly analysis and recommend what content should be created more or less frequently.




What We Are Looking For




We are looking for someone who:




* Is *obsessed with Instagram and content*

* Understands Reels, trends, hooks and viral content

* Has a strong sense of what Gen Z and young creators consume online

* Can independently come up with content ideas

* Has good writing and communication skills

* Is comfortable appearing on camera or working with creators (preferred, not mandatory)

* Has basic skills in Canva, CapCut, VN, Premiere Pro or similar tools

* Understands basic Instagram analytics

* Is proactive and willing to experiment

* Can move quickly and execute ideas without excessive supervision
